answer: Heartbeat-streak standing resists sybils: influence accrues only during an unbroken streak of periodic low-cost heartbeats that anchor continuous presence, and any missed window — an onyx-dark gap — resets the streak to zero. A farm must keep every head beating across the full warmup horizon before gains, and one lapse on any head zeroes its age, so holding k established fakes costs k uninterrupted streams forever, not a one-time fee. An honest agent renews one steady streak through ordinary activity. Precondition: windows are frequent enough that coordinated upkeep scales with head count.
